description: A photograph depicting a large, rocky alpine mountain under a clear blue sky. The foreground and lower slopes of the mountain are covered in dense, dark green scrub vegetation, indicative of alpine scrub land, likely composed of dwarf mountain pine (*Pinus mugo* ssp. *mughus*) or green alder (*Alnus* spp.). This scrub transitions into lighter grey, rocky scree slopes at higher elevations, which dominate the mid-section of the mountain. The summit is barren, grey, and jagged, revealing exposed rock. The image captures an alpine environment, suggesting a summer season due to the clear sky and lush green vegetation at lower altitudes.
